title: instantsearch.js/hierarchicaMenu rootPath option buggy behaviour
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**

A bug.

Reproducible case: https://jsfiddle.net/1mfdwqcg/18/

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

When using the hiearchicalMenu and the rootPath option, I get this behaviour:

![2017-03-31 15 14 00](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/24551953/e7f16782-1624-11e7-85dc-f8696e5e4433.gif)

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

It should be like this:

![2017-03-31 15 14 32](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/24551958/ed7bdfb6-1624-11e7-9c0e-33bbb107b777.gif)

Passing the `limit` options fixes the bug by asking the API to send back more facet values, but I believe we may not be sending the right facet filters to focus on receiving the lvl1 facet values to be able to always display them.

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**

All

**What project are you opening an issue for?**

* instantsearch.js

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**

Latest
